title: No quick fix for Pacers: Haliburton remains out, Carlisle calls for ‘grit and guts’

 Haliburton is out for at least a few more weeks as the Pacers work through early-season concerns. Plus, NBA Cup play against the Knicks and the unveiling of his Hali 2 sneakers.
 Scott Agness Nov 13, 2026 2 Share Jalen Slawson gave the Pacers a huge lift in the fourth quarter, beginning with a 14-0 run. (Photo: DAZN) Happy Friday the 13th to all who celebrate.
 Tonight, the Pacers play in their second of four NBA Cup Group Play games, hosting the New York Knicks. They are the only two teams in East Group B without an NBA Cup win this season.
